states.name: nato
states.description: US to act with NATO (Marshall Plan already played): afterwards the USSR can't coup or realign US-controlled Europe.

states.name: nato-needs-prerequisite
states.description: US holds NATO but neither Warsaw Pact nor Marshall Plan has been played: the event is refused.

states.name: nato-active
states.description: USSR to act with NATO in force; the US controls West Germany, Italy and France (with the US controlling France at 4-1). USSR can coup/realign none of them, but can still hit Poland.

states.name: nato-de-gaulle
states.description: As nato-active, but De Gaulle is also in force: France is exempt, West Germany is not.

states.name: nato-willy-brandt
states.description: As nato-active, but Willy Brandt is also in force: West Germany is exempt, Italy is not.

states.name: brush-war-nato
states.description: USSR to act with Brush War and NATO in force: US-controlled Greece can't be targeted.

states.name: special-relationship-nato
states.description: US to act with Special Relationship, NATO in force and the UK US-controlled: +2 influence in one Western European country and +2 VP.

states.name: us-japan
states.description: US to act with the US/Japan Mutual Defense Pact: Japan ends US-controlled and the USSR can't coup or realign it.

states.name: us-japan-active
states.description: USSR to act with the pact in force: Japan (US 4) is off limits, South Korea isn't.

states.name: formosan
states.description: US to act with Formosan Resolution.

states.name: formosan-asia-scoring
states.description: US to act with Asia Scoring, Formosan Resolution in force and the US controlling only Taiwan: Taiwan counts as a battleground.

states.name: formosan-china-card
states.description: US to act with Formosan Resolution in force and the China Card: playing it ends the event.

states.name: shuttle-diplomacy
states.description: US to act with Shuttle Diplomacy: it stays in effect (not discarded) until a Middle East or Asia scoring.

states.name: shuttle-me-scoring
states.description: US to act with Middle East Scoring and Shuttle Diplomacy in force; the USSR holds Iran, Iraq, Egypt and Jordan: one fewer USSR battleground counts.

states.name: willy-brandt
states.description: USSR to act with Willy Brandt.

states.name: flower-power
states.description: USSR to act with Flower Power.

states.name: flower-power-active
states.description: US to act with Flower Power in force and a war card in hand: spending it, for ops or event, pays the USSR 2 VP.

states.name: evil-empire-cancels-flower-power
states.description: US to act with Flower Power in force and An Evil Empire: playing it ends Flower Power.

states.name: we-will-bury-you
states.description: USSR to act with We Will Bury You and DEFCON 4; the US holds a card to spend next.

states.name: solidarity
states.description: US to act with Solidarity, John Paul II already played.

states.name: solidarity-needs-john-paul-ii
states.description: US holds Solidarity but John Paul II hasn't been played: the event is refused.
